_comment: Machine-readable summary of the PS3111-S11 facts established in this repository. Firmware SBFM21.1 unless noted. See docs/ for how each was verified.

protect_flag.note: any non-zero value makes IDENTIFY report SATAFIRM S11 / SBFM21W1; read live by FUN_60004c4c

2.condition: system-area scan found an ERROR_UNIT page

3.condition: unknown; read together with bit 2 by FUN_6000892c

error_unit_test.note: a mask test, not equality: 0xFFFFFFFF would also match. On this drive unwritten pages read as 0x00000000 through the VUC path, so they do not trigger it.

sequence.note: high byte 0xFF for user pages, otherwise a sub-type tag

ce_id.note: ce_bitmap address; use to verify CE selection

length_alt.note: low nibble repeats the sector count; byte 9 wins on disagreement

partial_frame_rule.n: run length of bits equal to bit 0 of byte 9, starting at bit 0
partial_frame_rule.mapping: frame[0 .. n*512) == device sectors [LBA + shift, LBA + 8)
partial_frame_rule.verified: 60/60 frames located by content hash on a known-good device
unsolved: masks that are neither a leading nor a trailing run: 0x38, 0x70, 0x83, 0x78

addressing.note: a firmware block spans four internal units; OOB ce_id makes the grouping visible
addressing.ce_encoding_note: Psychite uses the bitmap bit position (0/4/8/12); 4 and 12 silently re-read CE0/CE1 at page+2

read_modes.warning: a pSLC block read in MLC mode looks erased; verify by checking the OOB physical page index against the read order

observed_geometry.note: from the controller's own SYSTEM_INFO on one drive; not necessarily universal
